human_authorization.description: 100 real Player SHOT_TENDENCY updates in one verified active save, one bounded session with multiple team-chunks

scope.target_policy: If 0..99 => before + 1; if 100 => 99; all one-point changes, fresh live Getter required

test_plan.name: Frozen engine no refactor
test_plan.check: All runtime core files unchanged, only small one-shot harness and independent validator, no new writer

test_plan.name: Live snapshot validity
test_plan.check: Exact process start, exe hash, save+season+team/roster and cold backup fresh verified

test_plan.name: 100 distinct targets
test_plan.check: Exactly 100 unique (team,player,field) and 100 unique intent ids, all fresh Getter/CAS within legal bounds

test_plan.name: Single process preflight
test_plan.check: No competing REA writer or prior unresolved UNKNOWN claim; no new concurrency subsystem, do not claim global concurrency proof

test_plan.name: Synthetic replay
test_plan.check: 100 intents, multi team chunk, Node VM and fault injection on existing budget, no code change

test_plan.name: Live No-op
test_plan.check: Separate batch exactly 100 NOOP zero Setter, isolated Journal, each chunk validated

test_plan.name: Real 100 write once
test_plan.check: One batch 100 real attempts once, stop on failure, no retry/rollback

test_plan.name: Strict automatic receipt verification
test_plan.check: Every chunk identity/digest and intent set matched, per-item Getter before/after and field checks, conservation; no post hoc false pass

test_plan.name: Independent live readback
test_plan.check: New read-only session proves exact 100 after values and identifies misses

test_plan.name: Exact benchmark timing
test_plan.check: Separately report full wall, transport, no-op, preflight, readback, time per planned/success, attach/chunks, not extrapolated

provenance.old_live_12s: 7.23892s for 12 successful writes, 2 chunks and 1 attach
